links.outcome: Expected Calibration Error of model confidence in diagnostic outputs
links.effect: ECE of 0.275 reported for the fine-tuned model, indicating miscalibrated confidence; Top-1 accuracy 80% (8/10) and Top-3 100% on ten cases.
links.quote: The system achieves an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.275 and passes the Africa Deep Tech Challenge 2026 (ADTC 2026) memory budget constraint of 7168 MB, achieving a peak inference RAM of approximately 3630 MB on the standardised benchmark laptop.

unlisted_practices: Offline-first deployment of a small quantised fine-tuned LLM on low-specification hardware without cloud connectivity

screen.reason: The paper develops and benchmarks a quantized offline-first LLM (Aletheia) for differential diagnosis in low-resource settings, testing technical feasibility and accuracy without evaluating a clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
